REMOTE DATA ENTRY CLERK - WORK FROM HOME!!

A leading company is hiring remote data entry clerks immediately. No experience necessary. Earn $1,200 per week from home with flexible hours!

What you will do:
Complete simple online tasks and assist with various tasks as needed.

How it works:
After a short interview on Telegram, we will mail you a check. Deposit the check and use the funds to purchase your work equipment from our approved vendor. Any remaining balance must be sent back via Zelle.

To get started, send a copy of your passport and your bank account number to hr.department.jobs@gmail.com.

Positions fill fast, apply today before spots are gone!!
